blocks.text: Skeletal nizam bohat se amraz (disorders) ka shikar ho sakta hai jo is ki banawat aur kaam par asar dalte hain, is ke kisi bhi hisse mein: haddiyan, jor aur connective tissues.
Skeleton ke amraz
Disc slip

Vertebrae ke darmiyan intervertebral discs jhatka jazb karne wale ka kaam karti aur harkat mein madad deti hain. Herniated ya slipped disc tab hoti hai jab intervertebral disc ki bairooni tah phat ya toot jaye, jis se andar ka gel jaisa madda bahar ris kar qareebi asaab ya spinal cord par dabao dalta hai. Yeh chot (trauma), umr ke saath zawal ki tabdeeliyon, ya reerh par baar baar ke tanao se ho sakti hai. Is ki alamat mein mutasira jagah dard, sun hona aur jhunjhunahat, pathon ki kamzori ya kaam ka khona, aur shadeed sooraton mein pakhane ya peshab ka kharab kaam shamil hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: kamar ka nichla hissa peechhe se, reerh ki haddi ke saath; ek box aur surkh dhabba lumbar vertebrae dikhate hain. Daen: box ka bara manzar do vertebrae aur un ke beech disc dikhata hai jis ka andaruni maadda peechhe ko ubhar kar herniated disc banata hai aur peechhe chalti nerve ko daba deta hai. Labels: Lumbar vertebrae, Vertebra, Herniated disc, Pressed nerve.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.11: Disc slip (herniation) (kitab ki Figure 12.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Disc ka bahari khol phatne par andar ka narm maadda (surkh) bahar nikal kar nerve par dabao dalta hai; isi liye dard aur sunn-pan hota hai. Aksar yeh kamar ke lumbar hisse mein hota hai jahan wazan sab se zyada hai.
Spondylosis

Spondylosis reerh ki haddi ke vertebrae, intervertebral discs, ligaments ya cartilage ka zawal (degeneration) hai. Is se intervertebral discs tang ya jur sakti aur haddi ki ubhaar (outgrowths) ban sakti hain, jo asaab ya spinal cord par dabao dalti hain. Yeh nichli kamar (lumbar vertebrae) aur gardan (cervical vertebrae) mein sab se aam hai. Is ka sab se aam sabab intervertebral discs ka qudrati zawal hai; yeh umr, jeneti awamil, chot, tawil ghalat posture aur motape se hoti hai. Alamat mein kamar ya gardan ka dard, akran aur harkat ki kam range shamil hain.

blocks.alt: Disc ke saath paanch vertebrae ke do pehlu ke manzar. Baen, Normal Vertebral column: vertebrae ke darmiyan barabar discs. Daen, Spondylosis: vertebrae ke kinaron par bone outgrowths, ek tang (narrowed) disc aur peechhe ko ubhri hui slipped disc.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.12: Spondylosis (kitab ki Figure 12.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono columns ka muqabla karein. Spondylosis mein umr ke saath discs ghis kar patli ho jati hain, haddi ke kinaron par kaante jaise bone outgrowths ugte hain, aur kabhi disc khisak jati hai. Yeh sab asaab par dabao dal kar dard aur akran paida karte hain.
Sciatica

Sciatica sciatic nerve ka dabna ya khush-khush hona hai, jo nichli kamar se shuru ho kar koolhon se har taang mein neeche jati hai. Yeh aksar herniated ya bulging disc ke nerve par dabao se hoti hai; doosre asbab mein chot, infection, soozish aur spondylosis shamil hain. Alamat mein nichli kamar, koolhon, taangon ya pairon mein dard ya be-chaini, taangon ya pairon mein jhunjhunahat ya sun hona, aur taangein ya pair hilane mein kamzori ya mushkil shamil hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: jism ka nichla hissa peechhe se, nichli kamar se har taang mein jati sciatic nerve aur ek taang ke saath surkh dard ka ilaqa. Daen upar: lumbar reerh ka pehlu jahan herniated disc sciatic nerve ko dabati hai. Daen neeche: upar se dekha gaya vertebra jahan bulging disc nerve root par dabao dalti hai. Labels: Sciatic nerve, Area of pain, Herniated disc, Sciatic nerve compressed, Bulging disc.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.13: Sciatica aur us ki wajoohat (kitab ki Figure 12.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Sciatic nerve jism ki sab se lambi nerve hai. Jab kamar mein disc us ki jar (root) ko dabati hai to dard kamar mein nahin balke poori taang ke saath neeche mehsoos hota hai, jaisa surkh ilaqa dikhata hai.
Arthritis

Arthritis mein joron par asar dalne wali mukhtalif soozishi kaifiyat shamil hain. Tamam qismon ki alamat mein jor ka dard aur akran shamil hain; doosri mein mutasira joron mein surkhi, garmi aur soojan ho sakti hai. Osteoarthritis sab se aam qism hai: jor mein haddiyon ke siron ki articular cartilage batadreej narm ho kar toot jati hai; yeh ghutne, koolhe aur intervertebral joron par asar dalti hai. Rheumatoid arthritis ek autoimmune marz ka nateeja hai jis mein synovial membrane soozish-zada ho jati hai; aksar kalai aur haath mutasir hote hain. Gouty arthritis (gout) tab hoti hai jab khoon mein uric acid jama ho kar joron mein qalm banata aur soozish karta hai; sab se aksar mutasira jor bare angoothe ka hai, magar ghutne, kalaiyan aur ungliyan bhi mutasir ho sakti hain.

blocks.alt: Teen panels. Osteoarthritis: ghutne ka jor jis ki articular cartilage patli aur tooti hui hai (degenerated cartilage). Rheumatoid arthritis: ghutne ka jor jis ki synovial membrane moti, surkh aur suji hui hai (inflammation in synovial membrane). Gouty arthritis: upar se paon jis ke angoothe ka jor surkh aur suja hua hai aur us mein suiyon jaise uric acid crystals hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.14: Arthritis ki qismein (kitab ki Figure 12.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teenon mein jor mein dard hai magar wajah alag: osteoarthritis mein cartilage ghis jati hai, rheumatoid mein jism ka apna defence synovial membrane par hamla kar ke soozish karta hai, aur gout mein khoon ka uric acid crystals ban kar aksar paon ke angoothe ke jor mein jam jata hai.
Osteoporosis

Osteoporosis kamzor haddiyon ki kaifiyat hai jo fracture aur tootne ka zyada shikar hoti hain; yeh tab hoti hai jab haddi ki kasafat (density) kam ho kar haddiyan nazuk aur surakhdar ho jayen. Is ke asbab mein umr ke saath haddi ki kamiyat ka qudrati kam hona, jo kuch logon mein zyada numayan hai; auraton mein menopause ke baad oestrogen ki kami, jo haddi ke ziyan ko tez karti hai; khoorak mein calcium aur vitamin D ki kami, kyunke calcium haddi ki mazbooti ke liye nihayat aham hai aur vitamin D jism ko calcium jazb karne mein madad deta hai; wazan uthane wali warzish ki kami; corticosteroids ke tawil istemal jaise kuch ilaj; aur smoking aur sharab noshi shamil hain.

blocks.alt: Reerh ke pehlu ke manzar mein nishan zada lumbar vertebra se liye gaye spongy bone ke do chokor namoone: normal haddi jis mein bohat se chhote khane hain, aur osteoporosis wali haddi jis mein kam magar kahin bare khane hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.15: Normal haddi aur osteoporosis (kitab ki Figure 12.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab yahan khurdbeen ki tasveer chhapti hai; yeh us ka saada khaaka hai. Osteoporosis mein haddi ki kasafat (density) kam hoti hai: khane bare aur deewarein patli, is liye haddi halki si chot par toot jati hai.
Joron ki chotein
Jor mukhtalif choton ka shikar ho sakte hain jin se dard, soojan aur kam harkat hoti hai.

items: Dislocation (utarna): jor ki haddiyan achanak jhatke ya chot se apni mamool ki jagah se bahar dhakel di jati hain. Shadeed dislocation pathe, ligaments aur tendons phaar sakti hai; alamat soojan, shadeed dard aur jor ka na hilna hain. Rheumatoid arthritis bhi dislocation kar sakti hai. Utra hua jor sirf physiotherapist kamyabi se theek kar sakta hai, aur khinche ligaments ki marammat ya kasne ke liye surgery zaroori ho sakti hai.

Sprain (moch): jor mein haddiyon ko jorne wale ligaments ki chot, aksar takhne, ghutne aur kalai mein. Yeh tab hoti hai jab jor apni mamool ki range se aage zor se mura jaye, jis se ligaments khinch ya phat jate hain; andar mura pair bairooni ligament phaarta hai, bahar mura andarooni. Moch ka ilaj aam taur par physical therapy se hota hai, aur pattiyan (dressing) moch ko sakin rakhti aur sahara deti hain.

blocks.alt: Do qataarein. Normal elbow joint: daire mein humerus ka sira ulna ke khanche mein fit hai aur saath radius hai, paas mura hua bazu. Dislocated elbow joint: ulna aur radius humerus ke sire se peechhe dhakel diye gaye hain, aur saath ke bazu mein kohni ke peechhe ubhar hai. Labels: Humerus, Radius, Ulna.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.16: Kohni ke jor ka dislocation (kitab ki Figure 12.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Normal jor mein humerus ka gol sira ulna ke khanche mein beth kar hinge banata hai. Dislocation mein yeh haddiyan apni jagah se nikal jati hain, is liye kohni ki shakal bigar jati hai aur bazu hil nahin pata.

blocks.alt: Do qataarein. Foot turned inward: saamne se taang jis ka paon andar ki taraf mura (teer), aur bahar ki taraf se takhne ki haddiyan jahan outer ligament toota hai. Foot turned outward: paon bahar ki taraf mura, aur andar ki taraf se takhne ki haddiyan jahan inner ligament toota hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.17: Takhne ki moch (ankle sprain) (kitab ki Figure 12.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Paon jis taraf murta hai, us ki ulti taraf ka ligament khinch kar toot jata hai: andar murne par bahar wala, bahar murne par andar wala. Zyada tar moch paon ke andar murne se hoti hai.
Dislocation aur sprain ke liye first aid

items: Mutasira hisse ko sakin rakhein: use hilayein nahin aur utre jor ko khud seedha karne ki koshish na karein; limb ko sahara dene ke liye sling ya splint istemal karein.
Barf lagayein: mutasira jagah par ice pack ya thandi patti soojan aur dard kam karti hai.
Mutasira limb ko ooncha karein: dislocation mein, mumkin ho to, soojan kam karne ke liye limb ko ooncha rakhein.
Tibbi madad lein: dislocation aur sprain ko tibbi tawajjo chahiye, to emergency medical services 1122 ko call karein ya shakhs ko mazeed muaine aur ilaj ke liye hospital le jayein.

blocks.alt: Chaar numbered tasveerein: 1 Immobilize the affected area (bazu sling mein); 2 Apply ice (ghutne par barf ki thaili); 3 Elevate the affected limb (leta hua shakhs jis ki taang takiyon par oonchi hai); 4 Seek medical attention (doctor mareez ka muainah karta hua).
blocks.caption: Figure 12.18: Dislocation ya sprain ka first aid (kitab ki Figure 12.18 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Ek 70 sala khatoon jo shaz-o-nadir warzish karti aur tawil arse se corticosteroids leti hai, mamooli girne se kalai tor leti hai. Mumkina bunyadi kaifiyat ka naam batayein aur un ki kahani ke khatre ke awamil ginwayein.
blocks.explanation: Osteoporosis: un ki haddi ki kasafat gir gai hai, to haddiyan nazuk hain aur asani se tootti hain. Khatre ke awamil umr, menopause ke baad oestrogen ki kami, wazan uthane wali warzish ki kami aur corticosteroids ka tawil istemal hain; calcium aur vitamin D se khali khoorak, smoking ya sharab khatra barhatin.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Reerh: slipped disc asaab par gel risati hai; spondylosis tang discs aur haddi ke ubhaar wala zawal hai, aksar gardan aur nichli kamar mein; sciatica nichli kamar se taang tak sciatic nerve ka dabna hai.

Arthritis: osteoarthritis (cartilage ghisti hai; ghutna, koolha, reerh), rheumatoid (autoimmune soozish-zada synovial membrane; kalai, haath), gout (uric acid ke qalm; bara angootha). Osteoporosis: umr, menopause, kam calcium aur vitamin D, be-amli, corticosteroids, smoking, sharab se kam haddi ki kasafat.

Chotein: dislocation (haddiyan bahar dhakeli; physiotherapist, shayad surgery) aur sprain (ligament khincha ya phata; takhna, ghutna, kalai). First aid: sakin rakho, barf, ooncha karo, 1122 call karo.
